instruction: School Zone Repair and Occupancy Schedule This task starts from init.ifc. Reference images are provided on the Desktop: init_plan.png, init_section.png. Modify the Archicad model as needed and save the required outputs as result.txt, result.ifc, result.pdf. Export result.txt as a tab-delimited occupancy schedule text file from the Archicad schedule/list workflow. 1. The output folder contains result.ifc with size at least 500 bytes, result.pdf with size at least 500 bytes, and result.txt with size at least 20 bytes. 2. Result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema. 3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique. 4. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcBuildingStorey entity and exactly 8 IfcSpace entities. 5. The IFC model contains at least 4 IfcWall entities, and at least 1 IfcSlab entity. 6. The IFC model contains spaces with exactly these normalized names: CLASSROOM-1, CLASSROOM-2, CLASSROOM-3, COMMON, STAFF, WC-CHILD, WC-STAFF, STORE. 7. Every listed space is assigned to the single IfcBuildingStorey. 8. The shaped IFC product bounding box is within 0.5 m of min [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and max [18.0, 10.0, 3.0]. 9. Result.txt is tab-delimited and has exactly these headers in this order: RoomNumber, RoomName, OccupancyCategory, OccupancyLoad, Area. 10. Result.txt has exactly 8 data rows in this order: R01 CLASSROOM-1 Teaching 12.0 30.0, R02 CLASSROOM-2 Teaching 12.0 30.0, R03 CLASSROOM-3 Teaching 12.0 30.0, R04 COMMON Common 12.0 30.0, R05 STAFF Support 2.0 12.0, R06 WC-CHILD Support 2.0 6.0, R07 WC-STAFF Support 2.0 6.0, R08 STORE Support 2.0 8.0, with numeric values matching within tolerance +/-0.10. 11. Result.pdf has exactly 2 pages and extracted text contains at least these case-insensitive tokens: A101, A201, SCHOOL ZONE REPAIR AND OCCUPANCY SCHEDULE, CLASSROOM-1, COMMON, STORE. Any item not explicitly required may vary.
